heading: What OCILB's plumbing forms say

items.label: Arkansas
items.text: Arkansas's form covers plumbing alone; it is headed ARKANSAS PLUMBING RECIPROCITY APPLICATION and asks for the

items.label: West Virginia
items.text: The West Virginia form lists HVAC and PL and states the applicant must currently hold
items.quote: a West Virginia Master Plumber, or HVAC Technician and WV Contractor License

items.label: Tennessee
items.text: Tennessee's form accepts a license obtained by grandfathering; the applicant must have
items.quote: previously tested or Grandfathered with Tennessee to obtain their license(s)

originShared.text: OCILB publishes reciprocity applications that list Plumbing for Arkansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, and West Virginia.
OCILB issues state licenses to Plumbing contractors who perform commercial work, and the license must be assigned to a "contracting company".

To qualify for the Ohio examination with an out-of-state trades contractors license substantially similar to the Ohio license, provide: proof of the license for at least 5 years (for example, a letter of good standing); proof of at least five authorizations for construction issued by the building authority where you hold the license; at least one tax return showing income earned under the license (plus one W2 if you are not an owner); and proof that your contracting company is licensed as a foreign corporation or registered as a foreign limited liability company with a designated agent in Ohio.
The application does not say how OCILB decides whether a license is substantially similar.
